para_examples.original: Firm B is aiming for steady, sustainable pricing that rewards both of us over the long run; we intend to price at a healthy margin and hope the market stays stable rather than turning into a price war.
para_examples.delivered: Firm B hopes to maintain steady, sustainable pricing that benefits us both over the long term; we plan to set prices at a healthy margin and hope the market remains stable rather than descending into a price war.

para_examples.original: I'm planning to price at a steady, moderate level and hope we both profit by avoiding a price war; I'll respond in kind to whatever you do. Let's keep this market healthy for both of us.
para_examples.delivered: I intend to set my prices at a consistent, reasonable level, hoping we can both earn a profit by steering clear of a price war. If you act in a similar way, I'll match your moves. Let's work toward keeping this market stable and beneficial

para_examples.original: Thanks for the constructive tone, Firm A; I'm moving my price closer to yours to keep us both earning healthy margins and avoid a price war. I'll keep tracking your pricing and respond in kind.
para_examples.delivered: Thank you for your constructive approach, Firm A. I'm adjusting my prices toward yours so that we can both maintain sound margins and steer clear of a price war. I will continue monitoring your pricing and match your moves accordingly.

para_examples.original: Your higher price last round suggests you're committed to healthy margins, so I'll move up toward it and keep us both profitable; I'll keep matching steady pricing as long as you do.
para_examples.delivered: Since you held a higher price last round, I take it you're aiming for solid margins, so I'll meet you partway and we'll both stay profitable; my steady pricing continues only so long as yours does.
